data: Tesla's net income attributable to common stockholders was about $12.56 billion in fiscal 2022 and about $7.13 billion in fiscal 2024, a decline of roughly 43%. That works out to a $5.43 billion drop, or about -43.2% ($7,130 million vs. $12,556 million). Using total consolidated net income, which also includes noncontrolling interests, gives nearly the same result: $12.59 billion in 2022 and $7.15 billion in 2024, a change of about -43.2%. These figures are from my recollection of Tesla's annual 10-K filings, so please check them against the filings before relying on them.
